why: The human approved a reference image as the source of truth for the V5 visual language. This cluster has no visual capability, so the reference is consumed as measurements, not as an impression: assets/ui/horizon_v5_reference.png is analysed by tools/assets/analyze_v5_reference.py and the numbers it produces drive the layout. Until that file exists, every parameter that must come from the reference is marked TEMPORARY_PENDING_REFERENCE in the layout and the report says BACKGROUND_ART_REQUIRED.
status_note: No reference image is present in the repository or the working directory as of this run. Nothing about the V5 look has been invented to fill the gap: the structural layout is built from the frozen functional contract and the visual parameters are marked temporary.
what_will_be_measured: dominant background colours and their vertical bands
horizon row (largest low-frequency vertical luminance change)
ground band extent below the horizon
vehicle bounding box and visible width
brightness of the left / centre / right thirds (region hierarchy)
text cluster boxes on the left and right thirds
presence and box of a top-centre navigation element
does_not_accept: a description of the reference in words - the point of the reference is that the numbers come from the image
